messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout quadrupedal creature shown in side-three-quarter view facing right. It has a broad pale gray amphibian head with large round eyes, small nostrils, and a wide mouth, with pink feathery external gills fanning out from behind the head on both sides. Its underside and four thick wrinkled limbs are pale amphibian skin, the limbs ending in slender clawed toes. The entire back, flanks, and long tapering tail are covered in overlapping dark brown-gray pointed scales, the tail extending to the left beyond the frame.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat-snouted pale gray amphibian head with smooth mottled skin, wide mouth line and small nostrils", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body, facing right"}, {"looks_like": "large round dark eyes with pale blue-gray rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink fleshy stalks with fine red feathery filaments like an axolotl's external gills", "part": "gills", "where": "projecting sideways and upward from behind the head on both sides, four visible on the near side and three to four on the far side"}, {"looks_like": "thick pale wrinkled amphibian skin with transverse folds and dark speckling on the head", "part": "skin", "where": "covering the head, neck, underbody and limbs below the scaled covering"}, {"looks_like": "thick pale gray amphibian limbs with wrinkled skin and bent elbows and knees", "part": "legs", "where": "two under the shoulder area at the front and two under the hip area at the rear"}, {"looks_like": "slender splayed toes with small dark claws, five on each visible foot", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping dark brown-gray keratinous pointed scales in neat rows", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the entire back, sides and tail from behind the head to the tail tip"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering scaled tail with a narrow smooth pale edge visible near the base", "part": "tail", "where": "extending left and backward from the rear of the body out of the left side of the picture"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
